flags: Partial overview: guidebook caches 00 and 01 contain identical truncated book text ending in the Flat Rock section, not the Pee Dee route pages. The contents support Piedmont byway status, but not its road sequence, mileage, drive time, road-building history or route-specific designation rationale. Geographic anchors replace unsupported driving directions; overview is shorter than requested.

Dropped unsupported current claims: French establishment in 1913; Adrian Badin personally building the plant; World War I interrupting his dam and Alcoa buying it half-built; French colonial-inspired townhouses among the state’s earliest; Badin Lake north and Lake Tillery south from the overlook; Valley Drive/NC 24/27/73/Indian Mound Road routing.

Badin and Falls Reservoir pages retain Alcoa present-tense generation claims, but Badin Lake and Falls Reservoir report a February 2017 sale to Cube Hydro Carolinas. Omitted current operator claims. Badin page gives both 2007 shutdown and operation until 2010; omitted closure chronology.

Lake Tillery page conflates the surviving bridge with the 1922 original. Used the dedicated bridge chronology distinguishing the destroyed 1922 bridge and 1927 replacement; no current lane count asserted.
Indigenous quarry history is supported only by a secondary source without a named nation; no specific nation inferred.
